parts.name: Engine
parts.desc: More power across the rev range.

parts.name: Turbo
parts.desc: Small, medium or large. A small turbo comes on early, a large one comes on late with lag but hits harder.

parts.name: Weight reduction
parts.desc: Faster off the line and through corners.

tunes.name: Camber
tunes.tip: More camber grips harder in corners but costs a little launch.

tunes.name: Final drive
tunes.tip: Short gears pull harder, long gears reach a higher top speed.

tunes.name: Steering lock
tunes.tip: More lock turns tighter and suits drifting.

_turbos: Turbo sizes. onset/full are fractions of the redline where boost starts and reaches its peak (bar). gain is extra power at full boost. lag is spool time in seconds. taper is how much boost a small turbo loses near the redline.
